_comment: What people say (docs/PHASE4.md, step 4). Marco: a farmer-trader working the old road, friendly and careful. Trust level 1 after the first trade (DESIGN.md M1 row 2).

marco.name: Marco
marco.first: “You found my number, then. Marco. I trade up and down this road: salt, nails, cloth, a bit of everything. I pay in coin, the digital kind, same as I am paid. Half what I sell for, mind. A man has to eat.”
again: “Back again. Good. What do you need?”
“The road is quiet today. Let’s see what you have.”
“Careful past the farm. Those dogs have gone wild.”
“You look like a man who walks a long way for his salt.”
marco.callDay: “Bueno. I will be at the bus shelter on the old road. Come by daylight.”
marco.callNight: “Not in the dark, friend. The coyotes own the road at night. I will be at the shelter in the morning.”
marco.callWaiting: “I said I would be there, and I will. By the bus shelter, by day.”
marco.trust: Marco nods slowly. He trusts you a little now (trust 1).
marco.strike: Marco steps back, hands up. “Easy, friend. Easy.”
marco.bye: Marco tips his hat and goes back to the road.
